hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Track the frequency of each identifier across dynamic updates and output the largest frequency at each step.

hints.title: Handling Stale Entries
hints.text: Store pairs of current frequency and identifier. When frequencies change, push new pairs and discard outdated entries upon retrieval.

hints.title: Algorithm Steps
hints.text: Update frequency dictionary. Push pair onto max collection. Lazily remove collection tops where stored frequency does not equal current dictionary count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each query performs at most one push and amortized removals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all frequencies on each update requires O(n^2) total time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for frequency mapping and heap storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use lazy heap invalidation to track running maximum frequencies efficiently.
